sloka: ततः सूर्यं समुत्सृज्य राहुं फलमवेक्ष्य च ।उत्पपात पुनर्व्योम ग्रहीतुं सिंहिकासुतम् ।। ७.३५.४० ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sūryaṁ samutsṛjya rāhuṁ phalamavekṣya ca ।utpapāta punarvyoma grahītuṁ siṁhikāsutam ।। 7.35.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, having completely left the sun and considering Rahu as a fruit, Hanuman again sprang into the sky to seize the son of Simhika.
